decisions.reason: The construction dumper was only mentioned on the website, and the closely related mining vehicle lines were already dropped, so the firm seems to be moving away from vehicles and has little base left to learn from it and improve it.
The inclined furniture lift is a multi-model line with its own page and builds on the firm's lifting and material-handling know-how, so the firm can interpret early results and refine it.
The inclined building material lift shares its technology and customers with the furniture lift line and the firm's lifting experience, so related knowledge supports keeping it.
The truck-mounted furniture lift extends the inclined lift family, so the firm can apply its existing engineering and service know-how, though a single model is slightly less secure.
